# Site for sale

> Extending to c. 0.69 acres, this site at Crocknahattina offers an opportunity to create a home in an attractive countryside setting just c. 4.6km west of Bailieborough, subject to the relevant planning permission being obtained. The site is currently overgrown and requires clearing, but its position offers real potential.

## Fakta
- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Plocha: 2792.3 m²
- Lokalita: Crocknahattina, Bailieborough
- Cena: 35 000 €
